name: richard-terminal
install:
set -euo pipefail
export COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0
if [ -d "$HOME/.nvm/versions/node" ]; then
  NVM_BIN=$(find "$HOME/.nvm/versions/node" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -type d -name bin | sort -V | tail -1)
  if [ -n "$NVM_BIN" ]; then
    export PATH="$NVM_BIN:$PATH"
  fi
fi
hash -r
corepack prepare pnpm@11.28.10 --activate
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
start:
set -euo pipefail
if [ -d "$HOME/.nvm/versions/node" ]; then
  NVM_BIN=$(find "$HOME/.nvm/versions/node" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -type d -name bin | sort -V | tail -1)
  if [ -n "$NVM_BIN" ]; then
    export PATH="$NVM_BIN:$PATH"
  fi
fi
if curl -sf -o /dev/null --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:3000/; then
  exit 0
fi
exec pnpm dev -- --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port 3000
